summary: Caterpillar Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into material definitive agreements regarding the establishment of a new unsecured 364-day revolving credit facility of up to $3.5 billion, expiring August 26, 2027, with various borrowers including Cat Financial and international subsidiaries. It also amended and restated its existing three-year credit facility. The filing includes local currency addendums for borrowings in GBP, EUR, and JPY up to $100 million equivalents. These are routine credit facility arrangements, not a special situation. The agents are Citibank and MUFG. No transactional, restructuring, or corporate action elements are present.
